create_CameraHelper: create a CameraHelper instance with hitl_config and gui_input to manage camera yaw, pitch, and zoom
update_CameraHelper_update: update the CameraHelper with base_pos and dt to process WASD keys, mouse control, and scroll zoom
get_CameraHelper_get_xz_forward: get the XZ forward direction vector from the camera transform for horizontal movement
get_CameraHelper_get_cam_forward_vector: get the full 3D forward direction vector from the camera transform
get_CameraHelper_get_cam_transform: get the current camera transformation matrix as a magnum Matrix4
